_note: Seed list copied from the Notion Skills database on 2 Oct 2026. Descriptions are internal notes, not approved buyer copy. An empty description or download means it has not been written or uploaded yet.

skills.name: goal-superhuman
skills.description: Once at the start, then quarterly. Five questions, three lines you paste into COMPASS section 9, top 5 time sinks, a build list capped at 7.

skills.name: security-superhuman
skills.description: Before the first connector is switched on, then quarterly and whenever a chat or artifact is shared. Walks you through three Claude settings and reports the counts back.

skills.name: compass-superhuman
skills.description: Week 1, after the Goal. Builds COMPASS sections 1 to 8 from your own calls, docs, email and Notion, then asks only about gaps.

skills.name: context-superhuman
skills.description: Week 1, after the Goal is in section 9. The one full interview in the pack; proposes COMPASS sections 1 to 8 in the fixed layout plus the operating tables. Every other skill reads its answers instead of asking again.

skills.name: audit-superhuman
skills.description: Week 1, before building anything new. Counts projects, skills, scheduled tasks, prompts and chat habits; scores Live, Dead, Duplicate, Habit; maturity 1 to 5 from what ran; skills to build capped at 5.

skills.name: replies-superhuman
skills.description: Week 2, once. Clusters the replies you keep writing, cuts the yeses that work against the Goal, pulls your voice from sent mail, writes a second SKILL.md for your chief of staff agent. Drafts only.

skills.name: revenue-superhuman
skills.description: Week 3 and monthly. Revenue map by offer and per hour, the one lever, the leak, 10 ideas through three filters, a Moves list capped at 5.

skills.name: hooks-superhuman
skills.description: Week 4 and monthly. One platform, business or personal, the three calls that went best; 10 hooks with reaction evidence, 10 open loops, 5 drafts. Never posts.

skills.name: story-superhuman
skills.description: Week 4, then quarterly, or before a talk. Story bank of 8 to 15 from six transcripts, business arc and personal arc in five beats, slots table, Founder Story under 300 words.

skills.name: delegate-superhuman
skills.description: Daily and weekly once the Goal is set. Morning voice note to briefed tasks in the Tasks database; receiving a brief; building and testing the follow-up agent; the Friday review scored by formula.

skills.name: content-guardrails-superhuman
skills.description: Before any skill mines Granola or another AI notetaker for content. Interviews you, writes the Guardrails page and the Extraction Rules block other content skills read, then tests the rules on 3 real calls.
